sourceTitle: Wednesday the Tenth, A Tale of the South Pacific
description: "Wednesday the Tenth, A Tale of the South Pacific" by Grant Allen is a novel written during the late 19th century. Set against the backdrop of the South Pacific Islands, the story is narrated by Julian Braithwaite, the commander of a steam yacht named "Albatross", who undertakes adventures in pursuit of health and trade.
